guidance.SUBMITTED: Review intake details, confirm the category, and assign the responsible department.
guidance.UNDER_REVIEW: Complete staff review, then move the ticket to the responsible department.
guidance.ASSIGNED: The assigned department should start work or update the ticket if work has begun.
guidance.IN_PROGRESS: Monitor progress and mark the ticket resolved when field work is complete.
guidance.RESOLVED: Confirm the resolution is accepted, then close the ticket when appropriate.
guidance.CLOSED: No workflow action is expected unless the report needs to be reopened.
guidance.unknown: No next action is available for this status.
